items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Richard Payne. Did you know him? Richard Payne? Richard Payne? You mean some... Yeah. Yeah.

ctx.x: Can you remember any other early guitar players that you heard downtown? There was one fellow I never did hear anything about, Richard Payne.
